title: A Wish With a Mouth
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original 2D layered motion-comic BACKGROUND for Mochi Mayhem, portrait 2:3, 1024x1536-like. Cute confectionery fantasy, softly painted rich pastel color, crisp dark plum outlines, simple readable storybook shapes, glossy candy highlights, emotional and mysterious rather than horror. This is one full opaque environment only, NOT a mockup, not a comic sheet. Camera: gently elevated frontal theatrical staging so separate boss and Ruby puppets can move over it. Keep centre 45% width around middle 35–66% of canvas fairly empty and flat-lit for moving puppets; place narrative props at left/right and upper half. Bottom 28% is quiet dark plum/soft ground reserved for live Ruby narration. No text, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no UI, no drawn heroes, no drawn monsters, no bosses baked into the image. No extra mouths or eyes on roots/props. Render a complete polished environment, no empty transparency. Scene: Deep chamber below the Crown Oven. At back a colossal severable violet thorn ROOT with NO FACE and NO MOUTH arches down from ceiling, golden flavor wisps trapped in its translucent sap, cracked copper oven ducts left and right. The actual mouth-monster is NOT in this image, will be a separate animated puppet. Emotional theme: this is just one feeding root, not the whole Hunger.
